delivery.en: Collect at SVG Postal Corporation with a valid photo ID; letter boxes can be rented in Kingstown
delivery.zh: 到聖文森郵政憑有照片的證件領件；Kingstown 等地也可租用私用信箱

readback.en: A 784 number is grouped 3-3-4; 0 as zero; East Caribbean dollars; a.m. or p.m.; day before month
readback.zh: 784 號碼照 3-3-4 唸，0 唸 zero；東加勒比元；12 時制；先日後月

fraud.en: A hacked WhatsApp chat claiming you won money, or telling you to send funds by Zelle, is a scam
fraud.zh: 被盜的 WhatsApp 說你贏了錢，或叫你用 Zelle 匯款，都是詐騙

habits.en: Good day with strangers. Say mobile, not cell. Local payments are not Zelle; scammers may still name it. Day first.
habits.zh: 對生人說 Good day。說 mobile 不說 cell。本地通常不用 Zelle，詐騙者卻可能提到。

stall_local.en: I still need a passport or national ID at the Kingstown post office, and the bank app is frozen.
stall_local.zh: 到 Kingstown 郵局領件還得出示護照或國民身分證，而且銀行 App 當住了。

reason.zh: 不是聖文森日常轉帳工具；警方警示裡它是詐騙者要求的匯款方式
美國門廊交件；這裡是郵政窗口憑證件或租用信箱
美式活存名稱，當地較常直接說帳戶
美國稅局，不是本地詐騙文裡的機關

talk_style_diff.en: Polite Caribbean English, not mainland US slang. Stay calm if a chat mentions winnings or Zelle; use SVG Postal Corporation and East Caribbean dollar terms.
talk_style_diff.zh: 用客氣的加勒比英語，不要美國口語。若對話提到中獎或 Zelle，語氣保持穩住。郵務與金額用聖文森郵政、東加勒比元。

uncertain: 農民證等證件在電話裡會不會被提到，郵政頁有列，但通話頻率不明。
聖文森日期口頭順序是依當地常見英式習慣推得。
